donation_notice: Supporting the author is a voluntary donation. It does not unlock any features or change access to the application's functionality.
tip_project_repository: Open the SonicForge repository on GitHub in your browser.
tip_author_support: Open the author's support page in your browser. Donations are voluntary and do not unlock additional features.
link_open_failed: Could not open the link. Check your default browser settings and try again.
interface_language_hint: Changes apply immediately. Set the lyric recognition language separately in Lyrics.
tip_interface_language: Choose Russian or English for the interface. Lyrics and processing settings are retained.
description: Prepare music files: audio, metadata, and cover art.
title: Title
tip_preserve_lyrics: Preserves embedded lyrics and timing when metadata is updated or cleared, even when replacing other tags. Separate actions in the Lyrics tab remain independent.
audio_analysis_empty: Select one audio file to receive an analysis and recommendation.
audio_analysis_working: Analyzing loudness, dynamics, frequency balance, and background noise...
audio_preview_ready: Comparison is ready. Original and Result play at the same perceived loudness.
audio_single_file: Select one audio file for analysis or comparison.
audio_strong_warning: Warning: very strong processing is selected. It may cause distortion or reduce natural dynamics.
audio_recommend_minimal: balance loudness, protect peaks, and preserve the recording's character
audio_recommend_clean: gently reduce stationary noise and apply safe loudness normalization
audio_recommend_loudness: raise average loudness slightly while preserving dynamics
cover_preview_empty: Choose a song and click Preview cover
cover_preview_failed: Could not show the cover preview.
tip_cover_choose_custom: Selects a local PNG, JPEG or WebP. Its type and contents are checked before opening; the source file is not modified when it is fitted to a square.
unsafe_file: The file was rejected by the safety check: {error}
tip_lyrics_import: Opens a UTF-8 TXT or LRC file. LRC lines: [00:12.34]Text. The song is unchanged until you save.
tip_lyrics_timestamps: Displays each line’s time. Edit timestamps or paste your own LRC. Plain lyrics keep no invented timestamps.
tip_lyrics_timestamp: Inserts the field’s time before the current line. Give every LRC lyric line a [mm:ss.xx] timestamp; mixed input is checked before saving.
tip_lyrics_cursor_timestamp: Press F8 during playback to stamp 45 ms before the current position and advance to the next nonempty line. Without the player, use the editor cursor. Manually entered times stay exact.
tip_lyrics_separate_vocals: Local Demucs extracts vocals before the voice track is transcribed. Keeps the song timeline and original intact. Adds processing time; disable to compare with the mix.
lyrics_auto_preserved: Existing lyrics were preserved. Review the new result in the editor; use Save into song or enable overwrite to replace them.
lyrics_timing_requires_text: Load or paste existing lyrics first.
lyrics_status_aligning: Aligning existing words to the audio…
lyrics_status_alignment_error: Timings were not corrected; previous lyrics retained.
lyrics_timing_ready: Timings corrected; words retained. Review, then Save lyrics.
lyrics_timing_partial: Matched lines corrected. Lines retaining previous timings: {count}. Words and line order retained.
lyrics_timing_review: Alignment is ambiguous. Previous lyrics and timings were retained for review.
tip_lyrics_mode: Matches audio to supplied words, preserving line order and repetitions. Existing times restrict repeat searches to the nearest occurrence. Missing or uncertain lines keep their previous timings; other lines are corrected. Folders write output copies and skip songs without lyrics.
tip_lyrics_copy_all: Copies all lyrics, even without selection or during recognition. Ctrl+C in the lyric editor copies the selection, or all lyrics if nothing is selected.
tip_lyrics_language: Auto keeps Russian and English lyrics; other languages use Russian sound spelling by default. Latin letters remain available. This is an approximate transcription, not translation.
lyrics_status_empty: No lyrics loaded. Timed MP3 lyrics are stored inside the song.
lyrics_status_language: Detecting language across several parts of the song...
lyrics_status_sound_en: Sound spelling with English letters (not a translation)  •  quality: {quality}. Check the words.
lyrics_status_sound_ru: Sound spelling with Russian letters (not a translation)  •  quality: {quality}. Check the words.
lyrics_status_language_uncertain: Language could not be identified reliably. Select it manually; no guessed English text was saved.
lyrics_not_found: No matching TXT/LRC file or embedded lyrics were found.
lyrics_single_file: Choose one audio file to work with lyrics.
lyrics_empty: Enter or recognize lyrics before saving.
lyrics_recognized: Recognition complete. Recognized lines are shown in the editor — please review them.
lyrics_uncertain: Vocal recognition is uncertain. The detected text is shown for review and was not saved automatically.
lyrics_save_failed: Lyrics were recognized and displayed, but embedding failed: {error}
lyrics_saved_unsynced: Lyrics saved in MP3 without timestamps: {path}. Recognize the lines again for synchronized highlighting.
processing_audio_opt_in: Audio is off by default: enable it only to change loudness or apply effects.
lyrics_timing_batch_saved: {file} • {index}/{total}: timings corrected; lines with previous timings: {retained}. Words retained
lyrics_batch_completed: Processed: {total}. Saved: {saved}; preserved: {preserved}; need review: {uncertain}; failed: {failed}.
tip_show_splash: Clear this option to hide the loading window on future launches.
run_stopped: Processing stopped. Incomplete files were not published.
missing_source: Choose an audio file or a music folder.
missing_steps: Select at least one processing stage.
bad_seed: Seed must be an integer or empty.
metadata_single_file: Choose one audio file to read its metadata.
clear_confirm: Remove all metadata from the output copy? The source file will remain unchanged.
tip_source: A single audio file or a folder containing several songs.
tip_output: Finished files are published here only after all selected stages complete.
tip_title: Track title. Empty keeps the existing value; if none exists, the filename is used.
tip_genre: Leave empty for local musicnn analysis. Scores and alternatives appear in the log. Low confidence leaves the genre undefined.
genre_analysis_result: Genres {name}: {genres}. Alternatives: {candidates} (model score; segment support, not probability). Filename context: {context}. Status: {reason}
tip_overwrite_genre: Replaces the genre already stored in the file.
tip_overwrite_all_metadata: Removes existing tags and writes only the completed fields.
tip_read_metadata: Loads tags from the selected file into editable fields.
tip_clear_metadata: Creates an output copy without metadata. The source file is unchanged.
tip_integrated_lufs: Target average loudness. -14 LUFS suits most music.
tip_true_peak: Maximum peak after processing. A negative value reduces clipping risk.
tip_lra: Target loudness range: lower is steadier, higher preserves more dynamics.
tip_audio_profile: Choose the intended result. A profile adjusts several professional parameters together.
tip_audio_intensity: Controls how strongly the profile changes the sound. Zero leaves only safe loudness normalization.
tip_bass_gain: Boosts or reduces low frequencies. Double-click to reset to 0 dB.
tip_mid_gain: Adjusts vocals and core instruments. Double-click to reset to 0 dB.
tip_treble_gain: Adjusts brightness and high-frequency detail. Double-click to reset to 0 dB.
tip_stereo_width: 1.0 preserves the source width; lower narrows it and higher widens it.
tip_highpass_enabled: Removes frequencies below the selected value. The filter is fully off by default.
tip_lowpass_enabled: Removes frequencies above the selected value. The filter is fully off by default.
tip_denoise_mode: Auto only reduces noise when stationary background noise is detected. Manual always applies it.
tip_compressor: Reduces the difference between quiet and loud sections to make the recording denser.
tip_compressor_threshold: The level above which compression begins.
tip_compressor_ratio: The amount of gain reduction after the signal crosses the threshold.
tip_compressor_attack: How quickly the compressor responds to loud sound.
tip_compressor_release: How quickly compression stops after a loud section.
tip_compressor_makeup: Extra gain after compression. It is 0 dB by default.
tip_reverb_mix: Adds a sense of space and reflections. Zero fully disables the effect.
tip_fade_in: Duration of the gradual volume rise at the beginning.
tip_fade_out: Duration of the gradual fade at the end.
tip_sample_rate: The source sample rate is preserved by default when MP3 supports it.
tip_channel_layout: Mono or stereo is preserved from the source by default.
tip_mp3_quality: Maximum uses the best variable quality; other modes reduce file size.
tip_denoise_strength: Denoise amount. Available only while denoise is enabled.
tip_limiter: Restrains final peaks and reduces the chance of distortion.
tip_seed: Integer for repeatable artwork. Empty means 0; another number changes the pattern.
tip_cover_style: Custom theme uses your palette. Generated theme lets you choose color and pattern independently from M2Pv1, M2Pv2 and M2Pv3.
tip_cover_mood: Automatic mood comes from audio and lyrics; use this only to guide it manually.
tip_cover_text_mode: Show title and artist, title only, or leave the artwork without text.
tip_no_change_cover: Disables generation and embedding of new cover art.
tip_lyrics_recognize: Detects language across different parts and displays lines as they are recognized. Reliably recognized MP3 lyrics are automatically stored in USLT.
tip_lyrics_load: Loads existing lyrics from the selected song, or a nearby TXT/LRC if tags contain none. Does not run recognition or open a file picker.
tip_lyrics_save: Stores editor text in the selected MP3, replacing its USLT. Timestamps remain if the line count is unchanged. Other formats save TXT/LRC.
tip_lyrics_format: MP3 stores timed lines in USLT without a separate LRC file. TXT and LRC remain available for other formats.
tip_run: Runs selected stages in a temporary area, then publishes only completed files.
tip_stop: Stops current processing and removes incomplete output.
custom_style_description: The pattern follows the song's character; contrasting sections add small accents.
custom_palette_drag: Left: calm songs. Right: energetic songs. Drag stops; ← / → adjust precisely, Shift uses a smaller step.
custom_style_hint: Apply saves your palette and selects Custom theme. Then click Preview cover. M2Pv3 shows the opening on the left and ending on the right; filters run before lettering.
custom_save_failed:
Could not save custom style. Settings were not changed.
{error}
tip_custom_detail: Fine texture detail; in Music2Picture, the number of pattern layers.
tip_custom_contrast: Difference between light and dark areas. 100% preserves the chosen palette's contrast.
tip_custom_saturation: Color intensity: 0% gives a grayscale background; 100% preserves your colors.
tip_custom_softness: Softens only the background texture. 0% disables blur; text stays sharp.
audio_analysis_failed: Sound analysis failed. See the error message for details.
audio_analysis_sampled: Estimated from {seconds:.1f} s of {duration:.1f} s. This is a preliminary recommendation, not a full-song LUFS measurement.
editor_mix_source: Current editor mix — all unmuted lanes
editor_separate_hint: Separate: editor export is independent; other sections process the selected original.
editor_link_hint: Linked: other sections use the mix. No manual export needed; Processing saves the combined result.
tip_editor_pipeline: Off: the editor is independent. On: analysis, cover, lyrics and final processing use the current mix. Originals stay unchanged. Export works in both modes.
tip_editor_output_format: Working mix/result format without the Sound stage. If enabled, Sound produces MP3 using its own settings. Editor export format is selected separately.
editor_empty: Add editor audio and unmute at least one lane. Linked mode never substitutes the original for an empty mix.
editor_output_original: Choose another output folder: the result must not overwrite an editor original.
editor_wait: Wait for the editor task to finish or cancel it.
editor_lyrics_review_confirm: These recognized lyrics need review. Have you checked the words and approved saving the current text to the final file?
editor_preparing: Preparing the current editor mix for other sections…
editor_lyrics_staged: Lyrics saved to the working mix; the original is unchanged. Enable Lyrics and click Run to save the final file.
tip_stage_audio: Enable only to apply additional sound processing. Linked mode processes the editor mix; separate mode processes the selected original. Without this stage the working audio is copied without further processing.
tip_stage_metadata: Updates output tags using the Metadata tab fields.
tip_stage_lyrics: Reads existing lyrics or recognizes new lyrics in a separate stage. Reliable timed lines are stored in MP3 USLT.
tip_stage_cover: Generates artwork with selected settings. Embeds into output audio when embedding is enabled.
tip_language_button: Switches the interface language, not the lyric recognition language.
tip_help: Help for the open tab and its controls. F1 opens the same help.
help_hint: Right-click for tips • F1 — help for this tab
audio_scope: These settings apply to comparison and the Sound stage in Processing only. The editor is independent.
audio_summary:
Loudness → {lufs:.1f} LUFS • Bass {bass:+.2f} dB • Treble {treble:+.2f} dB • Stereo ×{width:.2f}
Peaks ≤ {peak:.1f} dBTP • Mids {mid:+.2f} dB • Gain ×{gain:.2f}
tip_audio_loudness: Changes target average loudness, not player volume. The LUFS value below shows the actual target; closer to zero is louder.
tip_audio_character: Softer cuts treble; brighter boosts it. Actual gain in dB is shown below. Mids are adjusted in advanced settings only.
tip_audio_bass_macro: Boosts or cuts low frequencies. 0 dB preserves source bass. Intensity scales this slider's effect.
tip_audio_space: Adjusts stereo width. ×1.00 keeps source width; lower narrows, higher widens. Mono cannot gain real stereo detail.
tip_audio_auto_denoise: Checks for stationary noise and applies a filter only if detected. Not vocal removal or restoration of damaged audio.
tip_audio_peak_protection: Limits peaks after processing to reduce clipping. Cannot fix distortion already recorded in the original.
tip_audio_analyze: Measures loudness, dynamics, frequency balance and noise in the background. No file writes; apply the recommendation separately.
tip_audio_apply_recommendation: Selects a profile from analysis and changes settings. Use Create comparison to hear the result.
tip_audio_preview: Creates temporary original/processed versions matched in perceived loudness. Does not alter the source or start Processing.
tip_audio_original: Plays the source version from the prepared comparison.
tip_audio_processed: Plays the processed comparison. Recreate comparison after changing settings.
tip_advanced_audio: Precise EQ, loudness, filters, compressor and effects. Values are retained when comparison is created.
tip_artist: Song artist. An empty field preserves the tag in normal update mode.
tip_album: Album name stored in output metadata.
tip_album_artist: Overall album artist, which can differ from the song artist on compilations.
tip_composer: Music composer, not necessarily the performer or lyricist.
tip_date: Release year or date, for example 2026.
tip_track: Track number in the album, such as 3 or 3/12.
tip_comment: A comment stored in song metadata. It does not affect cover generation.
tip_disc: Disc number in the release, such as 1/2.
tip_publisher: Publisher or record label stored in metadata.
tip_lyrics: Additional plain lyric metadata. Use the Lyrics tab for recognition and timed lines.
tip_choose_file: Selects one processing source for analysis, cover or lyrics. Does not add it to the editor.
tip_choose_folder: Selects a folder for batch processing. Output is a sibling SonicForgeProgect, not inside the source.
tip_choose: Changes the batch output folder. The editor selects its export file separately.
tip_metadata_actions: Read source tags, open additional fields or produce a copy without metadata.
tip_additional_metadata: Disc number, publisher, copyright and an additional text tag.
tip_cover_show_title: Styles the title to match the music and cover composition, using metadata or the filename.
tip_cover_show_artist: Adds the artist to the cover lettering when title is enabled.
tip_embed_cover_short: Processing embeds the completed image in audio. Preview displays an image without changing the song.
tip_cover_preview: Generates and displays artwork here. Does not start Processing or embed into the source.
tip_overwrite_lyrics: Allows batch recognition to replace existing lyrics. When off, existing lyrics are preserved.
tip_highpass_hz: Frequencies below this cutoff are removed only with the high-pass filter enabled. Unit: Hz.
tip_lowpass_hz: Frequencies above this cutoff are removed only with the low-pass filter enabled. Unit: Hz.
tip_copy_log: Copies the entire processing log to the clipboard.
tip_clear_log: Clears the visible log only, not files or settings.
audio_intro: Settings apply to comparison and the Sound stage in Processing. When linked, the current editor mix is used; otherwise the selected original is used.
custom_pattern_timeline: M2Pv3 — song structure from left to right
tip_cover_color: M2Pv1 — classic colors; M2Pv2 — musical character; M2Pv3 — local rhythm: slow is blue/violet, medium is blue/green, faster is red. Color follows rhythm changes throughout the song.
tip_cover_pattern: M2Pv1 — warped spectrum; M2Pv2 — organic folds; M2Pv3 — folds over song structure, opening on the left and ending on the right.
tip_lyrics_play: Listen to the song or editor mix. Click again to pause. Use the bar to seek.
tip_lyrics_stop: Stop playback and keep the current position.
